definitions.explanation: A device used to protect from rain or sun. In Japanese, the same word covers both rain umbrellas and parasols.

examples.japanese: {傘|かさ}を{持|も}って{行|い}きましょう。
{雨|あめ}だから{傘|かさ}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: It's raining, so I need an umbrella.

notes: 傘 can refer to both rain umbrellas (雨傘, amagasa) and parasols (日傘, higasa). Umbrellas are commonly left at umbrella stands (傘立て, kasatate) at entrances in Japan. Transparent vinyl umbrellas are very common.
